answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the thread of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The jade is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the garden.
